author: Vijf
body:
When appealing for a temp-ban/ban on the Avicus Network please include the following: 
  • Your Minecraft username(most recent name if changed: Matoma
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: Racism
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. ( I don't think I should necessary be unbanned but I want a shortened ban. I was in an argument with ElectricTurbo and he got warned and kicked while I didn't. I got straight banned without a warn or kick. So in my eye it's unfair that ElectricTurbo has a 4day Temp-Ban while I have a 7day Temp-Ban. 

Regards, 
Matoma

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello Budah,

The reason you're ban is longer than Ambi's, is because the punishment for racism is more severe then rudeness. The guidelines recommends a 6-8 day ban. The only reason you guys received a temp ban is because Ambi called Dilpickel autistic for not punishing you. This alerted me and I checke your logs. You said some pretty racist things, and you don't deserve a shortened punishment.

Regards,
Pelpelpajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
